Passion lies in transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive real-world impact. As someone who thrives at the intersection of technology and creativity, I’m driven by the potential of data to shape smarter ad strategies and connect brands with audiences meaningfully.  

At AdVerve Interactive, I focus on building scalable, reliable data pipelines that power our adtech solutions. My work spans from designing ETL processes to optimizing data warehouses, ensuring seamless integration between systems like Snowflake and Kafka. I’ve also contributed to real-time analytics workflows using Spark, helping refine targeting accuracy for campaigns. Collaboration is key—whether refining data models or automating infrastructure with Terraform, I aim to streamline processes and reduce friction.  

Recently, I spearheaded a project modernizing our data ingestion layer, which reduced processing latency by 30% and improved query performance. I’ve also automated deployment pipelines using Docker, cutting manual setup time by half. These efforts reflect my commitment to efficiency and innovation.  

Looking ahead, I’m eager to deepen my expertise in cloud-native architectures and explore how emerging technologies can further enhance adtech capabilities. Open to learning from peers and contributing to projects that push the boundaries of what data can achieve. Let’s build something impactful together.
